messages: Andrew is awake at home in Charleston, studying the word calendar. His library now holds 1071 books.
Vesper now carries verified walkthroughs for 25 games, including GTA 6.
Last night Andrew dreamed 10 dreams, and 6 were painted before morning. His Dream Library holds 556 dreams across 42 nights.
Vesper is tested in the open. In the latest completed round, Round 151, she scored 2 of 5.
NeuroCore, our study of a learning brain built on a recurrent core, is in its first phase of testing.
Vesper is coming to Xbox. Her Xbox app is built, her Microsoft developer account is verified and can publish to the Store, and release is expected in January.
